senses.gloss: a type of work or career that a person is suited for or feels called to do

definition_translations.ko_KR: 개인에게 적합하거나 소명으로 느끼는 일이나 직업
definition_translations.vi_VN: công việc hoặc nghề nghiệp phù hợp hoặc được xem là thiên hướng
definition_translations.th_TH: งานหรืออาชีพที่เหมาะกับบุคคลหรือรู้สึกว่าเป็นสิ่งที่ควรทำ

translations.th_TH: อาชีพทั่วไป
